intro.h2: Tile and stone work, done by the people you meet
paragraphs: Mastros Marble and Tiles takes on bathroom remodeling in Woodbridge, VA, with marble and tile work from a single shower to the whole room. Clients know the crew by name: Raphael and Jorge. One homeowner says they did an awesome job on their bathroom renovation and were timely, thorough and great to work with.

We also get called when a bathroom has gone wrong. Another client hired Raffaele to remodel an entire bathroom and to fix a leak that someone else had made worse. Our photos show the details we build in: large-format wall tile, a mosaic shower floor, a recessed niche and a solid curb.

about.text: Mastros Marble and Tiles is a small tile and marble company. The names clients mention are Raphael, also written Raffaele, and Jorge, and they describe them as timely, thorough and great to work with. Most of our reviewed work is bathrooms: full renovations, tiled showers and repairs to work that someone else left leaking. Our photos also show stone work, like a polished dark green hearth and wall surround. You can reach us by phone any day of the week, or see more of our photos on our Facebook page.

service_area.text: Mastros Marble and Tiles serves Woodbridge, VA, and we come to your home for bathroom remodels, tiled showers, marble and stone work and leak repairs. If you live outside Woodbridge and want to know whether your street is in range, call (703) 488-0600 or email mastrosmarbleandtiles@gmail.com with your town and a short note about the project. Clients also reach us through Google and our Facebook page, where you can see more of our photos.

items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: Bathroom remodels from start to finish, tiled walk-in showers with mosaic floors and recessed niches, marble and stone installation such as hearths and surrounds, and repairs to leaking or badly finished bathrooms. If your project is mostly tile or stone, call and describe it.

items.q: Can you fix a bathroom another contractor got wrong?
items.a: Yes. One client hired us after a leak that someone else had messed up and made worse. Raffaele fixed the leak and remodeled the entire bathroom, and the client says he would definitely recommend us. Tell us what happened when you call so we know what to look for.

Our Google listing shows us open 24 hours, seven days a week, so call (703) 488-0600 whenever it suits you. If we are on a job and cannot pick up, leave a message with your name and project, or email mastrosmarbleandtiles@gmail.com.

Marble is in our name, and Google lists us as a marble contractor. Our photos include a raised hearth and wall surround in polished dark green stone. Call to talk about vanity tops, shower walls, floors or other stone you want installed.

items.q: What should I send for an estimate?
items.a: Call (703) 488-0600 or email mastrosmarbleandtiles@gmail.com with the room, its rough size and a few photos of what is there now. That helps us understand the job before we come out to see it and talk through tile, stone and price.

final_cta.h2: Planning a new bathroom or shower?
final_cta.text: Call Mastros Marble and Tiles and talk it through with the people who will do the work.
